answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 401 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the knoll. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the lagoon queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. The zephyr index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Each copy needs 9 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
